page_title: HAV 1-2 LEN | Le Havre v Lens 24/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90+8' Robin Risser makes a brilliant save to deny Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) from the free kick. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Le Havre.

90+6' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Guillaume Paradis with no other option than to blow for a foul. Le Havre have a free kick.
90+3' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) is penalised for holding. Guillaume Paradis signals a set piece.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The corner from Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is cleared away by the defence.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) is coming onto the pitch as Wesley Said cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
84' Didier Digard has decided to substitute Arouna Sangante and he is replaced by Simon Ebonog (Le Havre).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Godson Kyeremeh (Le Havre) replaces Yassine Kechta.
80' A neat pass is well received by Wesley Said (Lens), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
79' Le Havre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
77' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Guillaume Paradis who sees an offensive foul.
73' Here is a change. Rayan Fofana is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Florian Sotoca (Lens) will replace Florian Thauvin.
73' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Ally Samatta will be replaced by Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre).
71' 5:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
67' Younes Namli (Le Havre) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
63' The substitution is prepared. Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rassoul Ndiaye.
63' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Younes Namli (Le Havre) replacing Fode Doucoure.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adrien Thomasson (Lens) was quite harsh and Guillaume Paradis didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fode Sylla.
56' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
51' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Wesley Said (Lens), whose header flies way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
47' Guillaume Paradis shows a yellow card to Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
46' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) makes a rough challenge and Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Guillaume Paradis has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' 1 - 2 Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Robin Risser. 1:2.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
45+3' Loic Nego (Le Havre) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Risser punches the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 11:2 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
44' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' That's unlucky! Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
43' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
40' 0 - 2 Goal! Wesley Said shows great vision to find Rayan Fofana (Lens) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:2.

38' Great ball in from Issa Soumare. Ally Samatta (Le Havre) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
35' Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle and it's Florian Thauvin (Lens) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' Loic Nego (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Guillaume Paradis blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Rayan Fofana (Lens) commits a foul during an attacking move.

28' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
26' Guillaume Paradis couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ally Samatta (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
25' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
24' The total number of attempts is 7:1.

23' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
23' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
19' Matthieu Udol (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
17' Loic Nego (Le Havre) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.

14' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
14' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' Fode Sylla (Lens) trips an opposition player and Guillaume Paradis signals a foul.
12' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Ally Samatta (Le Havre) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper. Le Havre force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Wesley Said (Lens) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mory Diaw into the bottom left corner.
9' Wesley Said (Lens) is going to take the penalty!
8' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Lens!!
7' Yanis Zouaoui (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillaume Paradis had an easy-decision to make.
4' Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
3' A player from Lens commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
3' It seemed like Adrien Thomasson (Lens) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Le Havre will have the kick-off.
Guillaume Paradis was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
